import logging

def test_basic_consistency(caplog) -> None:
    """Basic test from the issue."""
    def verify_consistency() -> None:
        assert caplog.get_records("call") == caplog.records

    verify_consistency()
    logging.warning("test")
    verify_consistency()
    caplog.clear()
    verify_consistency()

def test_multiple_clears(caplog) -> None:
    """Test that multiple clears work correctly."""
    for i in range(3):
        logging.warning(f"test {i}")
        assert len(caplog.records) == i + 1
        assert len(caplog.get_records("call")) == i + 1
        caplog.clear()
        assert len(caplog.records) == 0
        assert len(caplog.get_records("call")) == 0

def test_logging_after_clear(caplog) -> None:
    """Test that logging after clear works correctly."""
    logging.warning("before clear")
    assert len(caplog.records) == 1
    caplog.clear()
    assert len(caplog.records) == 0
    logging.warning("after clear")
    assert len(caplog.records) == 1
    assert len(caplog.get_records("call")) == 1
    assert caplog.records[0].getMessage() == "after clear"

def test_records_property_consistency(caplog) -> None:
    """Test that records property returns the same list as get_records."""
    records_prop = caplog.records
    records_get = caplog.get_records("call")
    # They should be the same list object
    assert records_prop is records_get
    logging.warning("test")
    # After logging, both should have the same records
    assert caplog.records is records_prop
    assert caplog.get_records("call") is records_get

def test_messages_and_text_after_clear(caplog) -> None:
    """Test that messages and text are cleared correctly."""
    logging.warning("test message")
    assert len(caplog.messages) == 1
    assert "test message" in caplog.text
    caplog.clear()
    assert len(caplog.messages) == 0
    assert caplog.text == ""
    logging.warning("after clear")
    assert len(caplog.messages) == 1
    assert "after clear" in caplog.text

def test_record_tuples_after_clear(caplog) -> None:
    """Test that record_tuples work correctly after clear."""
    logging.warning("test message")
    assert len(caplog.record_tuples) == 1
    caplog.clear()
    assert len(caplog.record_tuples) == 0
    logging.warning("after clear")
    assert len(caplog.record_tuples) == 1
